fields.note: Heathrow 2 m observations are mapped to the 100 m centre with 050's 6.5 K/km lapse and a constant vapour mole fraction. Real night inversions (warmer aloft: helps P2's cold edge) and daytime superadiabatic layers (cooler aloft: helps lift) are not represented.
